rationale.tokens: Rust-aware word tokens: identifiers, numbers and single punctuation characters (punctuation carries structure in code); whitespace and comment formatting do not matter.
rationale.normalization: case kept (Rust identifiers are case-sensitive), numbers normalized to 0 so changed constants still match, no punctuation removal, no diacritic folding.
rationale.n_grams: 10 tokens is roughly one line of Rust: long enough that single generic lines (derives, fmt signatures) are not shared shingles by themselves.
rationale.units: whole files plus 30-non-blank-line chunks (stride 15) on both sides so copied functions inside large files are comparable at similar size; benchmark answers (middles) of 5+ non-blank lines as their own unit; Edit examples contribute pre- and post-change files.
rationale.lsh: 14 bands x 8 rows: a pair with Jaccard ~0.72 has a 50% chance to become a candidate; ~0.5 rarely does.
rationale.verification: every benchmark doc in a cluster with any reth doc is compared exactly (shingle Jaccard and containment) against its best reth partner; verified = Jaccard >= 0.5, then inspected by hand.
